We formulate four main tasks: Assistant API Call Prediction, Multimodal Coreference Resolution (MM-Coref), Multimodel Dialog State Tracking (MM-DST), and Response Generation.
We evaluate this task in two different ways: (a) Generative ... BLEU-4 ... BERTScore ... (b) Retrieval ... recall@k ... mean reciprocal rank, mean rank.

We use n-gram overlap based BLEU-4 and more recent neural evaluation metric BERTScore to measure performance by comparing the generated response to the ground truth. Retrieval metrics like recall@k (k = {1,5,10}), mean rank, and mean reciprocal rank are used.
